instrument: Actual Binance SPOT daily UTC data. Long/cash only; no shorts, leverage, funding or pretending perp candles are spot.
channel: Previous completed close exceeds prior20 completed daily highs and EMA200. Entry next daily open. Exit via prior10-day low or protective/trailing stop.
ema: Previous completed EMA20>EMA50 and close>EMA200; entry next daily open. Exit next open after EMA20<=EMA50 or close<EMA200, or protective/trailing stop.
management: Initial2WilderATR14 stop from signal close;3ATR14 protective trail from previous completed closes. No fixed TP or short bar-age cap: separate swing research profile. No same-day reentry after exit. Invalid entry gap cancels.
stageAccounting: Each stage starts flat with prior data as indicator warmup. First200 observed days warmup. Fixed stage-end close virtual liquidation, with modeled exit costs; no reading next stage open.
gating: Only modes passing development may acquire/evaluate validation; only passing validation may evaluate the reused recent diagnostic. All cases retained; no parameter selection or release authority. These frequency-specific research gates do not override existing release/forward gates.
evidence: Different hypothesis and instrument/horizon from intraday futures studies. Primary motivation https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.12155 and authors' public code https://github.com/Globe-Research/bittrends . Fixed parameters here are HashiBot adaptations, not an exact paper replication. Stage years written before acquisition; no global project-wide untouched claim.
